metadata.article_title: Power to order separate trials where joinder of defendants may embarrass or delay trial.

article.title: Power to order separate trials where joinder of defendants may embarrass or delay trial.
article.content: Where it appears to the Court that any joinder of defendants may embarrass or delay the trial of the suit, the Court may order separate trials or make such other order as may be expedient in the interests of justice.]
article.html:
3APower to order separate trials where joinder of defendants may embarrass or delay trial.

Order 1, Rule 3A

Where it appears to the Court that any joinder of defendants may embarrass or delay the trial of the suit, the Court may order separate trials or make such other order as may be expedient in the interests of justice.]

2 Ins. by s. 52, ibid. (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
